messages:
june_cs: FYI sawmill-fin DAU tanked Tue morning. 70% drop in generation calls from their prod key. renewal ~6w. champion (CFO Lia) left two weeks ago, procurement pinged for vendor bakeoff (WavePilot). Anyone on this account?

omar_support: ugh. any errors or 4xx/5xx spikes?

june_cs: no big 5xx now, but origin shows many requests switched to a 'pilot' host. attached tiny CSV snapshot:
2026-03-10,9800
2026-03-11,9600
2026-03-12,7200
2026-03-13,3000
2026-03-14,2900

kevin_se: pulled routing logs -> client changed base_url to `https://pilot.wavepilot.com/v1` for a subset of keys on 2026-03-12 04:02 UTC. also noticed their tokenization changed after they upgraded our JS SDK to 2.1.0 last month -> avg tokens per request +14% which inflates cost when they do use us. snippet of config they pushed: 

```
{"service_url":"https://api.redwood.ai/v1","sdk_version":"2.1.0","enable_fast_tokenizer":false}
```

kevin_se: not sure if token delta caused them to try WavePilot, but it's a useful talking point (cost delta).

omar_support: opened a support ticket with their integration team asking when the switch happened and whether they intended a partial pilot. ticket #SUP-1219.

ops-bot: Incident ICM-2026-220 created (sawmill-fin-routing-change). Priority: medium. Assigned: kevin_se.

june_cs: booked a 25m sync with their new CTO + procurement for Mon 9am PT. Agenda: confirm pilot duration, share our recent perf/cost improvements, and surface the SDK tokenization note. Goal: stop switching traffic and buy a short trial window.

tess_ae: if we can get them to re-route 50% back to us for 2 weeks we can offer a performance/ROI pack and a Dedicated trial: 3-week trial, waived setup, plus 20% off first month. I'll draft offer.

kevin_se: engineering can prepare a thin-fix: opt-in fast tokenizer in SDK (small patch) + recommend a client-side cache to cut duplicate embed calls. Patch will reduce tokens ~12% in my bench. Can stage a canary for EU region.

june_cs: great. prioritize a one-page deck: 1) cost compare (current vs wavepilot) 2) perf numbers (p95 latency, error rate) 3) trial terms and SLOs. I'll send to their CTO pre-meeting.

omar_support: said contact replied: pilot is 6w but procurement wants supplier comparison by EOM. They asked for our SSO + SOC doc. passing to security for package.

tess_ae: I'll prepare an SOW and a 90-day optimization SLO addendum (2 SRE sessions, caching audit). AE will ask for exec intro with Procurement PM during the call.

kevin_se: for the SDK patch I can open PR today; request code owner review. If approved we can publish a patch release and a short migration note.

june_cs: tagging next steps: 1) kevin -> PR + canary plan, 2) tess -> SOW + trial terms, 3) omar -> keep support ticket updated, 4) security -> send SOC package. Report back here before Mon meeting.

ops-bot: Reminder: ICM-2026-220 status changed to investigating.

june_cs: thanks all. if procurement escalates before Mon ping me and I'll loop in revenue ops. :pray:
